description.zh: 需要查询的互动消息应用ID。
description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to query.

description.zh: 查询起始时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。若为空则默认为最早时间。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you leave this parameter empty, the earliest available time is used.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh: 查询结束时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。若为空则默认为最晚时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you leave this parameter empty, the latest available time is used.
The ID of the group to query.

description.zh: 需要查询的消息类型，若为空则默认为全部类型。
description.en: The type of messages that you want to query. If you leave this parameter empty, all types of messages are queried.

description.zh: 查询页的起始位置，若为空则默认为首页。
description.en: The starting page number for the query. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the first page.

description.zh: 一次显示的消息数量，取值范围**[10,50]**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **10 to 50**.

description.zh:
排序方式，按消息发送时间先后进行排序。取值：

- 1：正序

- 2：逆序
description.en:
The sort order based on the time when the messages were sent. Valid values:

*   1: ascending order
*   2: descending order

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive messaging group.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live list-live-message-group-messages --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --page-size 10 --sort-type 1 --next-page-token 1 --msg-type 1 --begin-time 1697783235 --end-time 1698301635 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ListLiveMessageGroupMessages --region cn-hangzhou --SortType 1 --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --PageSize 10 --EndTime 1698301635 --NextPageToken 1 --BeginTime 1697783235 --MsgType 1 --GroupId grouptest
